info.name: Staybnb API
info.description:
Auto-generated Postman collection for the Staybnb Express API.

Set the `baseUrl` environment variable to your server (default `http://localhost:8000`).
After running the Login request, the `token` variable is populated automatically.

Generated by `scripts/generate-postman.ts`.

request.description: On success this test script auto-saves `token` to the environment.
